text:
sasha_pm: Heads up — Lumenix dedicated cutover request. Target window: Thu Mar 25 22:00 UTC. Need approvals by EOD tomorrow. @alice_oncall can you cover the oncall runway?

alice_oncall: I can cover that window. Any DB/schema migrations or infra changes we should expect?

prashant_eng: No DB migrations. It's a model variant swap + quantized build. We'll pin model to v1.8.3-quant for parity with evaluation sets. Plan: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m observation between jumps.

ben_release: Add rollback thresholds: error rate > 3% sustained for 10m OR p95 latency > 800ms for 10m -> automatic rollback to fallback. Also need release notes and customer-facing changelog.

release-bot: Release artifact uploaded: https://internal.releases/redwood/lumenix/1.8.3. SHA: a7b3f9c. Generated checklist attached.

sasha_pm: Copying config here — confirm flags, canary slices, and fallback. If approved I'll pin the cutoff window.

```yaml
customer: Lumenix
deployment: dedicated
pool: lumenix-prod
version_pin: v1.8.3-quant
fallback_version: v1.8.2-fp16
canary_policy:
  steps:
    - percent: 10
      observe_mins: 15
    - percent: 50
      observe_mins: 15
    - percent: 100
      observe_mins: 30
rollback_criteria:
  - type: error_rate
    threshold_pct: 3
    window_mins: 10
  - type: latency_p95
    threshold_ms: 800
    window_mins: 10
notification: marta_sales
```

prashant_eng: LGTM. I'll run the canary automation and smoke tests (will post logs here). We'll also watch token-level cost delta during the 50% step.

alice_oncall: Acknowledged. I'll have SRE dashboard up and alerting tuned. Paging policy: page on rollback + sev2 on increased error budget burn.

ben_release: Approved from release side. I'll draft the notes and sync with @marta_sales to notify Lumenix operations 1h before cutover.

marta_sales: Will prepare the customer note and join the bridge during cutover. Please tag me for any scope changes.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: 1998769200 (Thu Mar 25 22:00 UTC) for customer lumenix on pool lumenix-prod. Canary automation enabled.

prashant_eng: deploy-bot — confirm canary sequence 10->50->100 with 15m intervals (last step 30m observe) and pin v1.8.3-quant.

deploy-bot: Canary policy confirmed. Version pin applied: v1.8.3-quant. Fallback target: v1.8.2-fp16. Auto-rollback hook enabled.

sasha_pm: All approvals collected: @alice_oncall, @prashant_eng, @ben_release, @marta_sales ✅. I'll lock the window and send calendar invites.

ben_release: Noted. If rollback happens we'll extend the window to allow investigation (target reset to 23:30 UTC) and send a postmortem within 24h.

sasha_pm: Thanks team — ping here if anything changes. :rocket:
